"""Telegram client abstraction."""

from typing import Protocol

from fastapi import Request
from telegram import Bot, InlineKeyboardButton, InlineKeyboardMarkup


class TelegramClient(Protocol):
    async def send_message(self, chat_id: str, text: str) -> None: ...
    async def send_inline_keyboard(self, chat_id: str, text: str, buttons: list[list[dict]]) -> None: ...


class MockTelegramClient:
    """Records sent messages for test inspection."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.messages: list[dict] = []
        self.keyboards: list[dict] = []

    async def send_message(self, chat_id: str, text: str) -> None:
        self.messages.append({"chat_id": chat_id, "text": text})

    async def send_inline_keyboard(self, chat_id: str, text: str, buttons: list[list[dict]]) -> None:
        self.keyboards.append({"chat_id": chat_id, "text": text, "buttons": buttons})


class LiveTelegramClient:
    """Production client wrapping python-telegram-bot."""

    def __init__(self, token: str):
        self._bot = Bot(token=token)

    async def send_message(self, chat_id: str, text: str) -> None:
        await self._bot.send_message(chat_id=chat_id, text=text)

    async def send_inline_keyboard(
        self, chat_id: str, text: str, buttons: list[list[dict]]
    ) -> None:
        keyboard = [
            [
                InlineKeyboardButton(
                    text=btn["text"], callback_data=btn["callback_data"]
                )
                for btn in row
            ]
            for row in buttons
        ]
        markup = InlineKeyboardMarkup(keyboard)
        await self._bot.send_message(
            chat_id=chat_id, text=text, reply_markup=markup
        )


def get_telegram_client(request: Request) -> TelegramClient:
    return request.app.state.telegram_client
